## Commercial and brand checks

- [ ] The first screen communicates a clear business problem or outcome.
- [ ] Copy is short, specific, natural, and consistent with Digvation as a digitalization partner.
- [ ] No client, metric, testimonial, certification, integration, or outcome was invented.
- [ ] The primary CTA is clear and visually dominant.
- [ ] New visual treatment reuses the existing system and does not feel template-driven.

## Product and technical checks

- [ ] Affected Indonesian and English experiences remain equivalent.
- [ ] Metadata, canonical URLs, language alternates, structured data, and links were checked when affected.
- [ ] Mobile, desktop, keyboard, focus, contrast, and reduced motion were checked when affected.
- [ ] Attribution, consent, inquiry delivery, and analytics success behavior were checked when affected.
- [ ] Removed files were confirmed unused by a repository-wide reference search.
